      --out <OUT>

          Disable automatic KB consultation, including stored session configuration

          Explicit task/size/environment facts for automatic loop advice [default: ""]

          Write the decision program of every mutant found equivalent over the full domain into this new directory, one canonical `<id>.zcve` each, as seed proposals for `optimize --with-candidate` and `loop run --seed`; each is marked with the transform checker's verdict
      --gaps

      --gaps-laws <GAPS_LAWS>
          With --gaps: a file of proposed laws, one `project.zeno` law declaration per line, checked against the contract's decisions and then measured

help.loop:
Propose, capture, learn, search, and inspect finite programs and contract decisions.

Use each subcommand's --help for inputs, schemas, hard limits, statuses and exit codes. Session commands use a fixed admitted reference and full-domain transform checks. Capture freezes executable observations; learning and search propose candidates. Meaning/evaluate inspect observations. Questions, restated rules and component simulation have separate scopes. No report grants application or publication authority.

Terms used in reports: an attempt is one proposal submitted to a session driver, including malformed and duplicate proposals. Typed feedback is structured JSON describing the checker outcome and its witness/reason. The incumbent is the retained best checked program (initially the original). Finite-program JSON, historically called fixture vocabulary, has exactly inputs, outputs, nodes and roots; Int bounds/literals are canonical decimal strings. A bound proposal names the exact reference and implementation hashes. Guarded stages run only when their input conditions hold. No session means no persistent ordinary loop directory or attempt ledger is created; a command may still write explicitly requested evidence.

All commands are bounded. The contained loop worker has a 64 MiB memory limit and a 25-second whole-run cap, plus a 1 MiB stdout cap. Search stages request at most five seconds of CPU and checks two, clipped by remaining wall allowance; stateless doors allow 22 seconds inside the worker cap. Session work/deadlines are frozen by open; stateless program doors have at most 131,072 tuples, 65,536-byte files and bounded search/check stages, with narrower caps documented by each command. Containment can return inconclusive before work starts. Help exits 0; invalid command-line usage exits 64. Operation-specific exits 0/1/2/3 differ: read status and detail, especially for run, meaning, teach-back, strategy and learn. See guide show loop-workspace and docs/CLI_REFERENCE.md.

  encode       Admit program JSON and write canonical bytes

One submitted proposal consumes one attempt, including malformed or duplicate proposals. Intake/replay work stays charged on earlier refusal; an unfinished expression precheck may return before an attempt. Expressions also get a confirming check and receipt replay before session submission.

help.loop capture:
Five operations share a bounded reference-capture protocol. The owner uses whole for one complete paged arithmetic comparison, or open to freeze an executable observation table in a private capture session. Packet exposes only the ABI, round and selected examples; the proposer submits candidate. Status returns owner-only evidence and rechecks stored success. These roles are a data-separation convention, not authenticated identities.

Inputs use finite-program ABI JSON or zeno-fcis/capture-expressions/1, not the ordinary loop-expressions document. Acceptance requires the existing transform checker and matching receipt replay over the complete observed finite domain. See each child for bounds and exits. Normal handlers use zeno-fcis/black-box-capture/2. Outer unavailable containment returns refused (1) under zeno-fcis/black-box-capture/1; an outer stop returns inconclusive (2) under that diagnostic schema. No runtime publication authority.

Usage: zeno-fcis loop capture [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  whole      Owner: check a candidate against a complete paged arithmetic reference domain.
  open       Owner: observe a complete executable reference and create a private capture session.
  packet     Public: read the capture ABI, round, and selected examples without private evidence.
  candidate  Proposer: check exposed examples, then compare with the complete frozen capture table.
  status     Owner: inspect private capture evidence and freshly recheck any retained success.

          Backend override; otherwise ZENO_FCIS_CONTAINMENT_BACKEND, then auto (finite data only)

          Ordered external KB files; omission consults ZENO_FCIS_KB for loop sessions

          Disable automatic KB consultation, including stored session configuration

      --kb-task <KB_TASK>
          Explicit task/size/environment facts for automatic loop advice
